help.body:
A quick guide to {title}.

**Tabs** (`Alt+number` switches at once)
- `Alt+1` chat · `Alt+2` sessions · `Alt+3` log · `Alt+4` artifacts · `Alt+5` status · `Alt+6` evolve

**Anywhere**
- `/` key: jump to the composer and open the slash menu
- The `⋯` button in the header: theme color, engine restart (repair)
- After a turn or more, new-chat and continue buttons show under the chat; switch there when a session gets long
- The `Sessions` tab opens a new session too

**Slash commands**
- `/btw <question>` a side question while it works · `/continue` new session with a context summary · `/new` a completely new session
- `/act <action>` (alias `/me`) an action or scene note instead of words
- `/private on|off` private talk · `/review` observation review
- `/status` status · `/clear` clear the screen · `/compact` compact the talk · `/defib`·`/reboot` engine restart

**Work decisions** (`/ticket <decision> number`, handled at once, never sent to the agent)
- `go` approve + start · `approve` approve · `decline` discard · `reopen` reopen
- Delegation: `delegate` run · `merge` approve · `rework number reason` rework · `discard` discard · `allow` allow paths

**Skills**: `/` alone lists the workspace skills that are on; `/skill name` searches them

Ask if anything else is unclear!
